# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 7

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 7:1 | "the-pure-food-of the-Many" | "the pure food of the Many" | "the sacred meal" | Terminology | LOGOS — "pure food" preserves tohorat; "sacred meal" imports connotations absent from Hebrew |
| 2 | 7:2-3 | "stubbornness-of-neck" | "obstinacy" | "stubbornness" | Word choice | LOGOS — "obstinacy" captures the Hebrew idiom without awkward literalism |
| 3 | 7:2-3 | "short-temper-of spirit" | "impatience of spirit" | "impatient anger" | Word choice | LOGOS — retains "spirit" (ruach) while being readable |
| 4 | 7:3 | "his own hand has delivered-him" | "his own hand has betrayed him" | "he has brought judgment on himself" | Idiom | Compromise — "his own hand has brought this upon him" preserves the Hebrew image without PNEUMA's abstraction |
| 5 | 7:4 | "the-Name-that-is-honored-above-all" | "the Name that is honored above all" | "the sacred Name" | Theology | LOGOS — fuller rendering of ha-nikhbad preserves the epithet; PNEUMA's "sacred" is too generic |
| 6 | 7:4-5 | "if he curses, whether when-struck-by distress" | "whether he curses while stricken by distress" | "whether he blasphemes while under affliction" | Word choice | LOGOS — "curses" is accurate to Hebrew; "blasphemes" (PNEUMA) imports NT categories |
| 7 | 7:5 | "while-blessing" | "while blessing" | "during prayer" | Interpretation | Compromise — "while praying" since the Hebrew mbrk can denote liturgical blessing, which is a form of prayer |
| 8 | 7:6-7 | "those-inscribed in the-book" | "who are registered in the book" | "whose names are enrolled in the register" | Expansion | LOGOS — PNEUMA adds "names" not in Hebrew; EMET's hyphenation is awkward |
| 9 | 7:8 | "through-inadvertence" | "inadvertently" | "unintentional" | Word choice | LOGOS — adverb form is natural English |
| 10 | 7:9-10 | "insults his neighbor and-not with-justice" | "insults his neighbor without just cause" | "unjustly insults a fellow member" | Structure | LOGOS — preserves word order closer to Hebrew while remaining clear |
| 11 | 7:12-13 | "borrows from the-property-of his neighbor without-asking" | "borrows from his neighbor's property without permission" | "takes a fellow member's belongings without asking" | Word choice | LOGOS — "borrows" + "without permission" is precise; PNEUMA's "takes" is too strong |
| 12 | 7:15 | "speaks foolishness" | "speaks foolishly" | "speaks idle nonsense" | Word choice | LOGOS — adverb is cleaner; PNEUMA's "idle nonsense" is a pejorative expansion |
| 13 | 7:16-17 | "lies-down and sleeps in the-session-of the-Many" | "lies down and sleeps during the session of the Many" | "falls asleep during the full assembly meeting" | Terminology | LOGOS — "session of the Many" preserves both technical terms; "assembly meeting" is redundant |
| 14 | 7:19 | "they-are-standing and he departs" | "they are standing and he departs" | "the assembly is standing for prayer" | Addition | LOGOS — text does not explicitly say "for prayer"; PNEUMA adds interpretive gloss |
| 15 | 7:19-20 | "goes naked before his neighbor, not being compelled-to-do-so" | "goes about naked before his neighbor without being compelled" | "appears undressed before a fellow member" | Word choice | Compromise — "appears naked" avoids LOGOS's "goes about" and PNEUMA's euphemistic "undressed" |
| 16 | 7:21-22 | "brings-out his left hand to-gesticulate with-it" | "extends his left hand to gesticulate with it" | "gestures with his left hand instead of his right" | Addition | LOGOS — PNEUMA adds "instead of his right" which is interpretive, not in the text |
| 17 | 7:22-24 | "slanders his neighbor... slanders the-Many" | "slanders his neighbor... slanders the Many" | "speaks maliciously about a fellow member... the community" | Word choice | LOGOS — "slanders" is direct; "speaks maliciously" is a periphrasis |
| 18 | 7:24-25 | "murmurs against the-authority-of the-community" | "murmurs against the authority of the community" | "grumbles against the community's leadership" | Word choice | LOGOS — "murmurs" is closer to Hebrew; "grumbles" trivializes the offense |
